one_line: BBC-Earth-level wildlife storytelling in 45-60 seconds — the animal kingdom's most extreme adaptations, showdowns, and survival tricks, visualized with AI.
audience: Nature-documentary fans, animal-fact accounts' followers, and anyone who stops for a 'no way that's real' wildlife clip.
tone: Cinematic wildlife documentary — BBC Planet Earth / National Geographic narration. Calm, precise, and awestruck, letting real biology carry the shock.
hook_templates: This animal has outsmarted scientists for decades.
Scientists still can't fully explain what {x} does.
{x} should not be able to survive this. Here's how it does.
This predator has a secret nobody expected.
{x} just broke a rule biology said was impossible.
Nature built the perfect killer, and it's smaller than your hand.
This is what happens right before {x} strikes.
The military actually studied {x} to build better technology.
{x} is stranger than anything a screenwriter could invent.
Here's the animal kingdom's most brutal survival trick, and it's real.
